AN ORDINANCE TO AMEND THE TREUTLEN COUNTY BEER LICENSE ORDINANCE, SO AS TO RESTRICT AND OTHERWISE PROHIBIT THE TRANSFER OF A BEER LICENSE.

On this day, the 374 day of _ April 2007, the Treutlen County

Board of Commissioners have met for the purpose of discussing and passing an amendment to an existing ordinance, so as to restrict and otherwise prohibit the transfer of a beer license;

WHEREAS, the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners believes that it is necessary to amend the existing Beer License ordinance, previously enacted on September 6, 1994, in order to restrict and otherwise prohibit the transfer of a beer license;

WHEREFORE, upon a motion and second by the Treutlen County Commissioners, the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners have hereunto passed and enacted the following amendment to said ordinance, known locally as the “Treutlen County Beer License Ordinance”:

Subsections (a) and (b) of Section Nine (9.) of said ordinance are hereby deleted.

There shall be no further transfers of existing beer licenses issued by Treutlen County, Georgia. In case of a transfer of ownership of a business, holding an existing beer license the successor owner may make application for a

beer license as specified by the existing ordinance and make payment of the full application fee. No transfers shall be made and no pro-ration of the license fee shall be accepted, regardless of when the application is filed during a calendar year. This amendment shall not bar or have any effect upon the renewal provisions and expense regarding an existing beer license.

Severability Clause: If any part or portion of this ordinance shall be ruled invalid, unconstitutional, or otherwise unlawful, the remaining body of the ordinance shall remain in full force and effect.

Repealer Clause: This amended ordinance effectively and immediately replaces and otherwise repeals any prior conflicting ordinance of the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners.

Effective Date: This ordinance shall become _ effective immediately, upon passage by the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners.

This the 3rd_ day of _ April , 2007.

Sas oy Bestendlet—

Chairman of the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners

Attest:

Clerk “bine Treutlen County

Board of Commissioners (SEAL OF COUNTY)
